sn48.49:2.1: “Sir, Venerable Bhāradvāja the Alms-Gatherer has declared enlightenment:
sn48.49:2.2: ‘I understand: Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’
sn48.49:2.4: ‘Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’ I understand”?
sn48.49:3.6: ‘I understand: Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’
